If you think the Spencer Pratt trutherism is fun now, just wait until control of the US House comes down to waiting a week for the results of a few districts in CA, later this year.
For those claiming fraud because Spencer Pratt did worse as the later ballots were counted, this chart is of the registered Dem share advantage over registered GOPs by each day of ballot returns.

Good news for Dems - the Dem margin has been steadily improving among all groups since Trump took office. And this is the first time, outside of pre-election bumps, that the Dem downward turn among Black voters has reversed.  And Dems have even improved substantially with whites.
Let's keep in mind, the GOP reportedly spent upwards of $80 million on their primaries in Texas, well more than double the amount spent by Dems.
Here are 4 districts the TX GOP gerrymandered to gain seats in November, with the Dem and GOP primary vote. Dems outvoted GOPs in every one of them.

Wow, the Dem primary turnout among Hispanic voters in Texas is going to be giving the GOP sweats for the next 8 months. 

Take Zapata County - turnout in the Dem primary there yesterday was 143% the total number of votes Harris won in the 2024 general election. That's wild.
